name: District / State / National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
governingActs: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (Section 63 for electronic records)

stages.name: Day-Zero Evidence Preservation & Pre-Litigation Escalation
keyCheckpoints: Preserve perishable evidence within 48 hours (invoices, raw chat/email exports, call logs, photos/videos)
Generate BSA 2023 Section 63 electronic evidence certificate
Run fast-track escalation (chargeback / RBI or sectoral Ombudsman / NCH INGRAM docket / Legal Notice)

stages.name: e-Daakhil / e-Jagriti Filing & Registry Scrutiny
keyCheckpoints: Verify pecuniary and territorial jurisdiction (including complainant's residence/workplace under CPA 2019 s.34(2)(d))
Check pagination, index, list of dates, memo of parties, and notarized affidavit
Cure any registry scrutiny defects within statutory window

stages.name: Admission & Issuance of Notice
keyCheckpoints: 3-minute admission pitch establishing consumer status, deficiency/unfair trade practice, and limitation
Obtain order issuing notice to Opposite Party (OP)

stages.name: Service of Notice & Proof of Service
keyCheckpoints: Track RPAD / Speed Post / approved electronic service
Pull corporate OP registered office and director email from MCA21 Master Data
File Affidavit of Service with India Post tracking report; seek deemed/dasti/substituted service if evaded

stages.name: Opposite Party Written Version (Reply) — 30+15 Day Hard Cap
keyCheckpoints: Track exact date of service of notice + copy of complaint on OP
If 45 days expire without Written Version, move application to forfeit OP's right to file reply (Hilli Multipurpose Constitution Bench rule)

stages.name: Rejoinder & Complainant's Evidence by Way of Affidavit
keyCheckpoints: File Rejoinder and Complainant Evidence Affidavit with exhibited documents + BSA s.63 certificate
Serve advance copy on OP and file proof of service so OP cannot seek adjournment claiming non-receipt

stages.name: Opposite Party (OP) Evidence by Way of Affidavit
keyCheckpoints: Verify whether OP filed its Evidence Affidavit within the time directed by the Commission

If OP defaults or seeks repeated adjournments after Complainant's evidence is already on record, move to close OP's right to file evidence (or impose heavy costs / 'Last Opportunity') and list directly for Final Arguments

stages.name: Written & Oral Final Arguments
keyCheckpoints: File concise Written Arguments in advance with binding precedent citations
Seek hearing-date compression citing CPA s.38(7) 90-day target if long dates are given
Oppose repeated adjournments and ask for costs or order-sheet recording

stages.name: Final Order, Execution (ss.71-72) & Appeal Defence
keyCheckpoints: Track compliance period (typically 30-45 days from order)
If unpaid, file parallel CPA s.71 (Recovery Certificate / attachment) and s.72 (penal warrant against directors)
If OP appeals, enforce mandatory 50% pre-deposit under CPA s.41
